# volcano_durable_function (Resource)

A long-running Volcano function that checkpoints its progress and resumes from the last checkpoint. The API has no update endpoint at all for this resource - every attribute change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_durable_function" "workflow" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  name       = "order-fulfillment"
  runtime    = "python3.13"
  source     = "${path.module}/dist/order-fulfillment.zip"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `runtime` (String)
- `source` (String) Path to a local zip or tar.gz archive containing the function's source code and dependency manifests.

### Optional

- `handler` (String)
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `variable_scope` (String)
- `variables` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `deployed_regions` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_durable_function.workflow <project-id>,<function-id>
```
